items.title: Govt Introduces Bill in Lok Sabha to Curb Paper Leaks
items.summary: The Union Government has introduced a Bill in the Lok Sabha aimed at implementing stricter measures and legal penalties to check paper leaks in public examinations.

or.title: ପ୍ରଶ୍ନପତ୍ର ଲିକ୍ ରୋକିବା ପାଇଁ ଲୋକସଭାରେ ବିଲ୍ ଆଗତ କଲେ ସରକାର
or.summary: ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ପରୀକ୍ଷାରେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନପତ୍ର ଲିକ୍ ରୋକିବା ପାଇଁ କଡ଼ା ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ଏବଂ ଆଇନଗତ ଦଣ୍ଡବିଧାନ ପାଇଁ କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ସରକାର ଲୋକସଭାରେ ଏକ ବିଲ୍ ଆଗତ କରିଛନ୍ତି।

items.title: RBI Gets Govt Approval for Polymer Rs 10 and Rs 20 Note Trials
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has obtained approval from the Central Government to conduct field trials for polymer-based currency notes in Rs 10 and Rs 20 denominations.

or.title: ପଲିମର୍ ୧୦ ଟଙ୍କିଆ ଓ ୨୦ ଟଙ୍କିଆ ନୋଟ୍ ପରୀକ୍ଷଣ ପାଇଁ RBI କୁ ସରକାରୀ ମଞ୍ଜୁରୀ
or.summary: ୧୦ ଟଙ୍କା ଏବଂ ୨୦ ଟଙ୍କା ମୂଲ୍ୟର ପଲିମର ମୁଦ୍ରା ନୋଟର କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ପରୀକ୍ଷଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଭାରତୀୟ ରିଜର୍ଭ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ (RBI) କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ସରକାରଙ୍କ ଅନୁମୋଦନ ପାଇଛି।

items.title: Developed Economy Requires Developed Financial Markets: RBI Dy Governor
items.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Jain highlighted that for India to transition into a developed economy, building robust and well-developed financial markets is an essential prerequisite.

or.title: ବିକଶିତ ଅର୍ଥବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ପାଇଁ ବିକଶିତ ଆର୍ଥିକ ବଜାର ଆବଶ୍ୟକ: RBI ଡେପୁଟି ଗଭର୍ଣ୍ଣର
or.summary: ଭାରତ ଏକ ବିକଶିତ ଅର୍ଥବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାରେ ପରିଣତ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରଥମେ ସୁଦୃଢ଼ ଏବଂ ବିକଶିତ ଆର୍ଥିକ ବଜାର ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିବା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ବୋଲି RBI ଡେପୁଟି ଗଭର୍ଣ୍ଣର ଜୈନ କହିଛନ୍ତି।

items.title: RBI Encourages PSU Banks to Pool Overseas Networks for FCNR(B)
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is encouraging public sector banks to pool foreign networks, dollar liquidity, and treasury support to boost FCNR(B) deposit mobilisation.

or.title: FCNR(B) ଜମା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଁ ବୈଦେଶିକ ନେଟୱାର୍କ ସଂଗଠିତ କରିବାକୁ PSU ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ RBI ର ଉତ୍ସାହ
or.summary: ବୈଦେଶିକ ମୁଦ୍ରା ଅଣ-ନିବାସୀ (ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ) ଜମା ସଂଗ୍ରହ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଁ ସରକାରୀ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ବୈଦେଶିକ ଶାଖା ଏବଂ ଡଲାର ଲିକ୍ବିଡିଟିର ମିଳିତ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବାକୁ RBI ଉତ୍ସାହିତ କରୁଛି।

items.title: Odisha Cabinet Approves 'Ama Similipal Yojana' for 200 Villages
items.summary: The Odisha government has approved the 'Ama Similipal Yojana' to boost local infrastructure and eco-tourism across 200 peripheral villages surrounding the Similipal biosphere.

or.title: ୨୦୦ଟି ସୀମାନ୍ତ ଗ୍ରାମ ପାଇଁ ଓଡ଼ିଶା ସରକାରଙ୍କ 'ଆମ ସିମିଳିପାଳ ଯୋଜନା'କୁ ମଞ୍ଜୁରୀ

items.title: Tata Power Selects Odisha for 10 GW Ingot Manufacturing Plant
items.summary: Tata Power has finalized Odisha over Andhra Pradesh as the destination for setting up its massive 10 GW ingot manufacturing plant.

or.title: ୧୦ GW ଇଙ୍ଗଟ୍ ପ୍ଲାଣ୍ଟ ପାଇଁ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ରପ୍ରଦେଶ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତେ ଓଡ଼ିଶାକୁ ବାଛିଲା ଟାଟା ପାୱାର

items.title: SC Orders Pan-India Rollout of Odisha HC Ruling on APAAR ID Consent
items.summary: The Supreme Court has ordered the nationwide implementation of the Odisha High Court's verdict concerning mandatory consent forms for APAAR ID generation.

items.title: Land Acquisition Starts for Rs 58,042 Cr Petrochemical Complex Near Paradip
items.summary: Odisha has initiated the land acquisition process for establishing a major petrochemical complex near Paradip with an investment of Rs 58,042 crore.

quiz.question: For which denominations of currency notes has the RBI received government approval to conduct field trials using polymer?
quiz.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India has obtained approval from the government to conduct field trials for polymer notes in Rs 10 and Rs 20 denominations.

quiz.explanation: Tata Power picked Odisha over Andhra Pradesh for setting up its 10 GW ingot manufacturing plant.

quiz.question: What is the total estimated investment for the proposed Petrochemical Complex near Paradip for which Odisha has started land acquisition?
